guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest anomaly (latency-90 +913%, z=+182) and CPU jumped from 2.66 to 18.78 (+607%, z=+36), while recommendationservice, its only caller with a large latency rise, is downstream of it in the service map. Socket (+50%) and memory (+46%) rose only modestly, and no error or warning logs exist, so CPU is the best fit, though a caller-driven load increase cannot be fully excluded.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice for CPU saturation (e.g. a hot code path or CPU throttling), and temporarily scale out replicas or raise CPU limits while investigating; no data deletion is involved.
